handouts.title: DASH Diet Guide - A Heart-Healthy Approach to Eating
handouts.description: A practical guide to the DASH diet for patients managing blood pressure and cardiovascular health. Covers what to eat, portion guidance, sodium targets, and how the diet reduces blood pressure.

handouts.title: Eating Out on a Low Carbohydrate or Ketogenic Diet
handouts.description: Practical guidance for eating out on a low-carbohydrate or ketogenic diet. Covers how to navigate restaurant menus, what to order, what to avoid, and how to handle social situations without compromising your diet.

handouts.title: Electrolyte Replacement on a Ketogenic Diet
handouts.description: How to maintain healthy electrolyte levels on a ketogenic diet. Covers sodium, potassium, and magnesium — food sources, supplement options, and how to manage keto flu symptoms.

handouts.title: Your Guide to the Ketogenic Diet
Hypoglycemia Recognition and Management
handouts.description: How to recognise and treat low blood sugar (hypoglycaemia). Covers symptoms, the 15-15 rule, when to call for help, and prevention strategies for patients on insulin or sulfonylureas.

handouts.title: Peri-Procedural Rules for Low-Carb/Keto Diabetic Patients
handouts.description: Essential rules for patients on low-carbohydrate or ketogenic diets before surgery, procedures, or bowel preparation. Covers when to stop low-carb eating, medication adjustment, minimum fasting periods, and when to contact your clinic.

handouts.title: Reading Food Labels on a Low Carbohydrate or Ketogenic Diet
handouts.description: How to read food labels on a low-carbohydrate or ketogenic diet. Covers net carb calculation, hidden sugars, misleading health claims, and how to compare products at a glance.

handouts.title: Spanish Mediterranean Diet Guide
handouts.description: A practical guide to the Spanish Mediterranean diet. Covers the principles of traditional Spanish Mediterranean eating, key food choices, what to avoid, olive oil as the primary fat source, and the role of fish, legumes, and vegetables in this diet pattern.

handouts.title: Managing Illness Safely on Your SGLT2 Medication
handouts.description: Sick day rules for patients taking empagliflozin (Jardiance), dapagliflozin (Forxiga), or canagliflozin (Invokana). When to hold your medication, ketone monitoring, and when to seek emergency care.

handouts.title: Understanding Sugar Substitutes - Patient Handout
handouts.description: A practical guide to sugar substitutes on a low-carbohydrate or ketogenic diet. Covers which sweeteners are safe, which to avoid, their effect on blood sugar and insulin, and how to use them without compromising your diet goals.
